camel_example: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeLogDeliveryConfigs --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --NextToken 'AAAAAINZ+8pH1oQnusEu1tGAc8is' --InstanceId 'waf-cn-zz11sr50000' --DeliveryNameLike test --MaxResults 20 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DeliveryType kafka
description_en: Queries all log delivery configurations of a Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance for hybrid cloud
description_zh: 查询所有混合云日志外发投递配置
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-log-delivery-configs --instance-id waf-cn-zz11sr50000 --delivery-name-like test --delivery-type kafka --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --next-token AAAAAINZ+8pH1oQnusEu1tGAc8is --max-results 20 --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLogDeliveryConfigs

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html获取当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the log delivery configuration that you want to query. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的外发投递配置名称。您可以设置该参数，模糊查询某个外发投递配置
parameters.name: delivery_name_like

parameters.help_en:
The type of the log delivery configuration that you want to query. Valid values:

syslog: Log delivery to a syslog server.

kafka: Log delivery to a Kafka cluster
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的外发投递配置类型。取值为：

syslog：表示外发到syslog服务。
kafka：表示外发到kafka服务
parameters.name: delivery_type

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group to which the WAF instance belongs
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken returned in the previous call. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 下一页查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次 API 调用返回的NextToken参数值。首页查询无需传入
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页个数。取值范围为：1-50，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results
